about: The register writes the balance firmware sends at every boot, in order, first at 115200 baud and again at 921600 in case the sensor is already there. Volatile: nothing is saved in the sensor. Each is checked against the firmware's source by tools/check-hardware.py.

meaning.binary_output: register 75, binary output 1: async mode 3 (both serial ports), rate divisor 1 (800 Hz), group 1, fields 0x0028 (YawPitchRoll, AngularRate)
